topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct; customer data confidentiality agreement signed before access; POL-01 4.8 sanctions applied in the March 2026 Store 17 case
evidence: Signed agreements (P07 PS-6: 25 of 25); sanctions log

control_description: Audit committee (2 sponsor directors, 1 independent director) receives quarterly cyber risk reports from the vCISO
gap: Quarterly reporting formalized only from 2026-09; one meeting on record
remediation: Hold and minute each quarterly report through the observation period

control_description: Information Security Officer designated; reporting lines and authorities in POL-01 section 3
Background checks before hire; annual training; role-based training for developers and administrators
gap: No role-based training for data recovery specialists, the partner claims desk, or Store Managers

control_description: Control owners named in the SSP, policies, and POA&M; sanctions for violations
SIEM, inventories, and SYS-01 reports support control operation
gap: SYS-01 exports and application events not collected; inventory gaps (9 bench PCs, 6 terminals)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies published on the intranet; annual acknowledgment
gap: Runbooks and partner duties not yet communicated to stores and the claims desk; store staff do not re-acknowledge yearly
remediation: Incident binders and briefings (POAM-010); annual acknowledgment

control_description: Partner questionnaires answered; customer intake notice and privacy page
gap: Intake notice overstated controls at 14 stores; no service commitments document or interconnection schedule for partners
remediation: Correct the notice (POAM-020); service commitments in the system description; interconnection schedules (POAM-024)

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives for the claims fulfillment service (acknowledgement time, repair time, outcome accuracy, confidentiality) set in the 2026 strategic plan
Enterprise risk assessment with SP 800-30 (P01, 50 risks) including partner service risks
Fraud risks identified (refund fraud, business email compromise, partner billing disputes)
gap: Refund exception report reviewed monthly, not weekly; call-back rule not applied to refunds
remediation: Weekly refund review; extend call-back verification (P01 R-020, R-022)

control_description: Changes to the claims service go through pull requests
gap: No security or risk review for new services, vendors, or AI features (5 AI uses adopted without review)
remediation: Security review step in change and purchasing workflows; AI intake (POAM-022)

control_description: Annual independent assessment by the co-sourced internal audit firm (P07); monthly security metrics
Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M and reported to the COO monthly and the audit committee quarterly

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the SP 800-53 Moderate baseline against P01 risks (P02)
Technology general controls for access, change, and operations
gap: Baselines missing for legacy bench and container images; infrastructure changes approved by email

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Policies POL-01 to POL-05 approved 2026-09-17
gap: Six of 11 standards still in draft
remediation: Issue the standards on the P06 schedule

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Identity provider with MFA; SYS-01 roles; restricted passcode field; encryption in SaaS and cloud
gap: Legacy credential notes readable by all roles; older lab shelf unencrypted

control_description: Accounts created from the HR feed with manager approval; partner systems registered with certificates
Quarterly SYS-01 access reviews; customer data access standard
gap: Leavers active in manufacturer portals (9 of 25); local accounts never reviewed; technicians at 14 stores can open and copy any device content

control_description: Badge access at the Depot, lab, and IT rooms; locked device cabinets
gap: Store keys not logged at 6 of 8 visited stores; terminal inspections incomplete at 9 stores

control_description: Depot sanitization certificates per device
gap: Store drop-offs without records; no validation step; recovered data and records kept past retention

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Site and cloud firewalls; WAF and mutual TLS for the partner API
gap: 12 flat stores; checkout page not protected against script injection

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS for portal and API; mutual TLS for partners; encrypted transfer drives
gap: Legacy bench PCs allow any USB storage, so device content can leave uncontrolled

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on office endpoints and 190 of 238 bench PCs; allowlisting on tablets; image signing
gap: 48 legacy bench PCs without EDR; unexplained scripts on the checkout page

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Quarterly scans (monthly internet-facing); annual penetration test; cloud posture service
gap: 7 of 40 Critical findings late; configuration drift not monitored on bench images

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: MSSP 24x7 monitoring of identity, EDR, network, and cloud signals
gap: SYS-01 exports, portal and API application logs, and the checkout page are not monitored

control_description: MSSP triage and escalation within 30 minutes
gap: Insider device events cannot be evaluated from logs at 14 stores

control_description: Runbooks for device data exposure and point-of-sale compromise (P08)
gap: Runbooks not yet exercised; partner notice procedure new

control_description: Write-once backups in a separate account; images and infrastructure code
gap: No contingency plan; partner API recovery never tested

control_description: Pull requests with a peer reviewer and separate production approver; signed images
gap: No security scanning in the pipeline; infrastructure changes without records

control_description: Cyber insurance; BIA; risk treatments
gap: No contingency plan; Depot is a single site for the claims repair service

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Tier 1 vendor reviews (5 completed); partner agreements
gap: 7 vendors with customer data lack security and data-use terms; 4 Tier 1 reviews outstanding

control_description: Capacity monitored for the API, portal, and SD-WAN; managed gateway scales
Write-once backups in a second region; cellular failover at stores; dual ISP at the Depot
gap: No alternate site for Depot claims repair; SYS-01 vendor RTO 8 hours exceeds the 4-hour need
remediation: Alternate receiving at two large stores; vendor recovery terms at renewal (P01 R-010, R-035)

control_description: Backups exist; one file restore in 2025
gap: No recovery testing of the partner API or the lab

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: Data classification (POL-04); claim data classed Confidential
gap: Claim data mixed into a marketing list; retention not enforced

control_description: Retention schedule in POL-04; purge at device release for passcodes
gap: Lab purge job broken; records since 2016; backups hold expired data

control_description: Processing objectives (claim acknowledgement within 4 business hours, repair within 5 business days, accurate outcomes) in the partner agreements
gap: Objectives not translated into documented processing specifications for the API
remediation: Processing specification in the system description (POAM-023)

control_description: Partner API validates claim messages against the schema and rejects malformed input; duplicate claim numbers rejected
Claims become SYS-01 tickets automatically; technicians record outcomes
gap: No exception queue for claims that fail to create tickets

control_description: Outcomes and costs posted back to partners; weekly invoice reconciliation
gap: No daily reconciliation between SYS-01 outcomes and messages posted to partners; errors found only at invoicing (P01 R-047)

control_description: Claim records stored in SYS-01 and the reporting database
gap: Partner retention terms not configured in SYS-01
